description:
Cross Platform Xray-core Client

OneXray is a cross-platform Xray-core client for managing proxy configurations and VPN/TUN connections.
OneXray v26.8.2 is a maintenance release for the macOS outside App Store
(OneXraySE) build only. Other platforms are unaffected.
What's Changed
- Reverted the Apple VPN routing changes introduced in v26.8.1.
- Removed the Exclude Local Networks setting.
- Existing OneXraySE users should remove the OneXray VPN configuration from
  macOS System Settings, then reconnect so OneXray can create it again.
